metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance company's claims platform" {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "Owned and operated by the insurance company; policyholders use it to report claims and track their progress" {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Web Application" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Service" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Service" "Registers new claims"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Web Application" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Service" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        dataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress via the mobile app" "HTTPS"

        webPortal -> intakeService "reaches" "HTTP"
        webPortal -> assessmentService "reaches" "HTTP"
        webPortal -> payoutService "reaches" "HTTP"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches" "HTTP"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches" "HTTP"

        mobileAppBackend -> intakeService "reaches" "HTTP"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "reaches" "HTTP"
        mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "reaches" "HTTP"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches" "HTTP"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches" "HTTP"

        intakeService -> triageService "hands accepted claims" "HTTP"
        triageService -> assessmentService "routes claims" "HTTP"
        assessmentService -> payoutService "requests settlements" "HTTP"

        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims" "HTTP"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads" "HTTP"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes" "Email/SMS"

        fraudScreeningService -> dataBureau "consults" "HTTPS"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "executes settlements" "HTTPS"

        policyVerificationService -> policyDatabase "checks the cover" "SQL"
        reinsuranceAllocationService -> claimsDatabase "reads large losses" "SQL"
        intakeService -> eventQueue "publishes claim events" "AMQP"
        eventQueue -> triageService "delivers claim events" "AMQP"
        payoutService -> auditDatabase "writes the compliance audit trail" "SQL"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "Containers" "Container diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope "Landscape"
    }
}
